jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Premium cinematic 2.5D pixel-art assets for THE GREAT LITTLE WORLD. Cohesive with detailed dew-covered emerald grass, warm gold highlights and deep teal shadows, crisp handcrafted pixel clusters, natural convincing textures, no smooth vector illustration, no fuzzy painting, no lettering, UI or labels. Asset type: isolated environmental sprite atlas, EXACT 3 columns x 3 rows, square 1536x1536, generous transparent gutters, genuinely transparent alpha. Three-quarter RPG camera looking down 30 degrees. Every object fully contained in one equal cell. Row1 left: huge gnarled old garden tree base with bark, forked roots, a small hollow and moss, no leafy crown, vertical composition; middle: clump of elegant fresh-water cattail reeds with brown seedheads, green leaves and tiny dew; right: blue-violet bellflowers with slender stems and leaves. Row2 left: a real delicate orb spider web stretched between two small forked twigs, transparent between silk strands, no spider; middle: a cluster of small amber and cream bracket fungi on a short broken wood stump, NO magical glow; right: freshwater water-lily pad with a white flower, top-down water-edge object, no water or background. Row3 left: unfurling curled fern with fine emerald fronds, individual plant not scenery; middle: layered grey stone with muted mint lichen and tiny moss islands; right: dry dandelion-like seedhead with a few loose seeds attached, thin pale filaments, natural tan stem. No people, insects, ground shadows, ground plane or scenery. Balanced readable silhouettes, consistent scale and detail.

Use case: stylized-concept. Premium cinematic 2.5D pixel-art assets for THE GREAT LITTLE WORLD. Asset type: production PARALLAX LAYER SHEET, portrait 1024x1536, EXACTLY three horizontal equal panels of 1024x512 stacked vertically, with transparent background and no divider lines. Each panel is one wide camera layer to be composited over a moving RPG world; do NOT make three complete landscape paintings. Keep wide empty transparent centers. TOP panel: distant soft teal-green grass canopy silhouettes along the bottom third, thin distant stalks and distant leaf tips at left/right, gentle golden haze in foliage only, upper two thirds transparent. MIDDLE panel: richly detailed emerald fern and clover edge bank at left and right lower corners, sparse arc-shaped grass blades reaching inward at outer 20%, center 60% and upper middle completely transparent, shallow moss bank only at very bottom edge. BOTTOM panel: oversized sharp foreground glossy emerald leaves with veins and dew entering from left and right edges and two corners, strong dark teal undersides, CENTER 65% COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT; no bottom floor. Layer edges may touch outer panel edges but never touch other panel. Fixed level camera, no horizon line. No creatures, characters, objects or sky rectangle. Real alpha, no colored matte, no baked blur.
